ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Persistence Via GlobalFlags
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects registry persistence technique using the GlobalFlags and SilentProcessExit keys

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\.*") AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Image\\ File\\ Execution\\ Options\\\\.*") AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\GlobalFlag.*")) OR ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\.*") AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SilentProcessExit\\\\.*")) AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\ReportingMode.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\MonitorProcess.*"))))
